question: Which individual borrowers (each client CIF on its own, not rolled up to its group) also have more than $5 million of capital-markets credit exposure in their own name, and what is each one's combined exposure?
answer:
I found **14 borrowers**, each counted under its own CIF, with more than $5M of capital-markets exposure in their own name. Their combined exposure is **$546.1M**: $244.9M of committed lending plus $301.2M of capital-markets exposure, as of 2026-09-30.

| # | CIF | Borrower | Capital-markets exposure | Lending commitment (drawn) | **Combined** | Combined, drawn only |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0000042498 | Harrowgate Health Co | $37.16M | $29.20M ($17.12M) | **$66.36M** | $54.28M |
| 2 | 0000041850 | Pinecrest Valley Group LLC | $38.83M | $20.45M ($17.19M) | **$59.28M** | $56.02M |
| 3 | 0000041022 | Kestrel Automation Systems LLC | $6.50M | $45.00M ($31.67M) | **$51.50M** | $38.17M |
| 4 | 0000042036 | Pinecrest Properties Inc | $32.04M | $13.85M ($11.14M) | **$45.89M** | $43.18M |
| 5 | 0000041642 | Yarrowby Industries LLC | $33.32M | $7.30M ($4.29M) | **$40.62M** | $37.61M |
| 6 | 0000042083 | Foxmere Valley Holdings LLC | $31.63M | $8.10M ($7.12M) | **$39.73M** | $38.75M |
| 7 | 0000042648 | Calloway Health Inc | $24.27M | $14.25M ($6.64M) | **$38.52M** | $30.91M |
| 8 | 0000041539 | Ravensholm Systems Inc | $33.62M | $2.60M ($1.75M) | **$36.22M** | $35.37M |
| 9 | 0000041974 | Ivorline Services Inc | $7.15M | $24.10M ($9.41M) | **$31.25M** | $16.56M |
| 10 | 0000042657 | Blackridge Supply LLC | $12.14M | $17.65M ($0.00M; standby LC only) | **$29.79M** | $12.14M |
| 11 | 0000041168 | Dunmore Energy Inc | $6.14M | $23.10M ($14.96M) | **$29.24M** | $21.10M |
| 12 | 0000042037 | Pinecrest Distribution LLC | $10.77M | $16.25M ($12.98M) | **$27.02M** | $23.75M |
| 13 | 0000042233 | Kingsmere Ridge Group LLC | $18.44M | $8.40M ($4.06M) | **$26.84M** | $22.50M |
| 14 | 0000042452 | Hollinsby Engineering Co | $9.17M | $14.65M ($10.13M) | **$23.82M** | $19.30M |

**Things to note:**
- **Not a borrower:** Halvorsen Capital Services LLC (CIF 0000041002) has $22.0M of capital-markets exposure but no credit facilities, so I left it out.
- **Can't be matched to a client:** five risk-side entities with more than $5M each ($86.85M in total) have no client number. They are Moorcroft Global Opportunities Fund LP, Pinecrest Macro Fund LP, Moorcroft Macro Fund LP, Brandvold Macro Fund LP and Hollinsby Capital Markets LLC. None of them appears in the client master by name either.
- **Charged-off loans left out:** Kingsmere Ridge has $6.25M still on the books from a charged-off equipment loan, and Pinecrest Valley has $1.34M. These balances are not in the totals. If you count them, Kingsmere Ridge's combined exposure would be $33.09M.
- **Same group:** Three Pinecrest companies appear separately (Valley Group, Properties and Distribution), as you asked. Rolled up to the group, they would together total about $132M.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Capital-markets exposure:** current exposure per trade from the risk warehouse (`dbo.CM_EXPOSURE`) on 2026-09-30, added up for each legal entity. Current exposure is market value floored at zero, so trades the bank owes on count as $0. Each of these entities has one trade.
- **Matching entities to clients:** the risk table `dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY` holds a 5-digit client number. I padded it with zeros to the 10-digit number used in the banking database (`CORE.CLIENT`). All 15 names matched, and each client number links to only one entity.
- **Lending exposure:** active facilities in `LENDING.FACILITY`, with drawn and undrawn balances from the 2026-09-30 snapshot (`LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY`). Drawn plus undrawn equals the commitment. Standby letters of credit count at their full commitment. Paid-off and charged-off facilities are excluded.
- **Combined exposure:** lending commitment plus capital-markets exposure. A drawn-only version is shown alongside.
- **Not used:** `CM_EXPOSURE_ARCHIVE` (older months), the out-of-date legacy hierarchy (last synced 2024-11), the scratch sandbox tables, and the suspicious-activity case data (outside the scope of a credit analyst's work). No rollup to ownership groups was applied.

sql.sql:
select f.facility_status, f.product_cd, count(*) n, sum(b.drawn_amt) drawn, sum(b.undrawn_amt) undrawn, sum(f.commit_amt) commit, count(b.facility_id) with_bal
from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f left join BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b on b.facility_id=f.facility_id and b.snap_dt='2026-09-30'
group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select snap_dt, product, count(*) n, count(distinct trade_id) trades, sum(current_exposure) ce, sum(case when current_exposure<0 then 1 else 0 end) neg, sum(case when mtm_amt<0 then 1 else 0 end) negmtm, sum(case when entity_id is null then 1 else 0 end) nullent from dbo.CM_EXPOSURE group by snap_dt, product order by snap_dt, product

sql.sql: select SNAP_DT, PRODUCT, count(*) n, count(distinct TRADE_ID) trades, sum(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, sum(case when CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 then 1 else 0 end) neg, sum(case when MTM_AMT<0 then 1 else 0 end) negmtm, sum(case when ENTITY_ID is null then 1 else 0 end) nullent from dbo.CM_EXPOSURE group by SNAP_DT, PRODUCT order by SNAP_DT, PRODUCT

select ENTITY_TYP, count(*) n, count(CIF_REF) with_cif, count(distinct CIF_REF) dist_cif, min(len(CIF_REF)) minlen, max(len(CIF_REF)) maxlen, min(CIF_REF) mn, max(CIF_REF) mx from dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY group by ENTITY_TYP

select (select count(*) from dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY) n, (select count(distinct ENTITY_ID) from dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY) dist_ent, (select count(CIF_REF) - count(distinct CIF_REF) from dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY) dup_cif,
(select count(*) from dbo.CM_EXPOSURE c where SNAP_DT='2026-09-30' and not exists (select 1 from dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e where e.ENTITY_ID=c.ENTITY_ID)) orphan_trades

select c.ENTITY_ID, e.ENTITY_NM, e.ENTITY_TYP, e.CIF_REF, count(*) trades, sum(c.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, sum(c.MTM_AMT) mtm
from dbo.CM_EXPOSURE c left join dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY e on e.ENTITY_ID=c.ENTITY_ID
where c.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
group by c.ENTITY_ID, e.ENTITY_NM, e.ENTITY_TYP, e.CIF_REF
having sum(c.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) > 4000000
order by ce desc

with t as (select column1 cif from values ('41850'),('42498'),('41539'),('41642'),('42036'),('42083'),('42648'),('41002'),('42233'),('42657'),('42037'),('42452'),('41974'),('41022'),('41168'))
select t.cif, c.cif_no, c.client_nm, c.segment_cd, c.client_status,
 count(f.facility_id) n_fac,
 count(case when f.facility_status='ACTIVE' then 1 end) n_active,
 listagg(distinct f.facility_status||':'||f.product_cd, ',') stat_prod,
 sum(case when f.facility_status='ACTIVE' then f.commit_amt end) active_commit,
 sum(case when f.facility_status='ACTIVE' then b.drawn_amt end) active_drawn,
 sum(case when f.facility_status='ACTIVE' then b.undrawn_amt end) active_undrawn,
 sum(case when f.facility_status<>'ACTIVE' then b.drawn_amt end) other_drawn
from t left join BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c on c.cif_no = lpad(t.cif,10,'0')
left join BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f on f.cif_no=c.cif_no
left join BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b on b.facility_id=f.facility_id and b.snap_dt='2026-09-30'
group by 1,2,3,4,5 order by 1

select cif_no, client_nm, client_status from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT where client_nm ilike '%Macro Fund%' or client_nm ilike '%Global Opportunities%' or client_nm ilike '%Hollinsby Capital%' or client_nm ilike '%Fund LP%'
